children.value: > Fact From Story Public Betting Patterns: If a significant amount of money is being placed on one team or participant, sportsbooks might adjust the odds to balance their liability.
> > Fact From Story By making the odds less favorable for a heavily-bet team and more favorable for the less-bet team, they can encourage more even betting.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Encouraging even betting reduces risk.
> Commonsense Knowledge Sportsbooks want to make a profit.
